title: Very Bad
body:
I am deeply disappointed with Emirates NBD and their lack of flexibility when it comes to handling genuine customer mistakes. I recently submitted a Plus Points redemption request by mistake and immediately contacted customer service to reverse the transaction. Despite explaining the situation clearly and requesting their support, my request for reversal was declined without any understanding or consideration.

What frustrates me the most is the complete lack of empathy and unwillingness to assist a loyal customer. The entire process felt mechanical and unhelpful — as if customer satisfaction means nothing to them.

I have been banking with Emirates NBD for years, and this experience has completely changed my perception of their service. A reputable bank should be able to handle such minor issues with some degree of flexibility, especially when the request is made promptly and in good faith.

This experience has convinced me to reconsider my relationship with Emirates NBD and to warn others to be cautious when dealing with them. Once a mistake happens, even an honest one, don’t expect any support or understanding.

title: Extremely disappointed with ENBD’s Security and Customer Support
body:
Banking with Emirates NBD (ENBD) no longer feels safe due to their poor security measures and lack of proper customer support. I recently experienced repeated fraudulent transactions on my credit card. I immediately called customer service within 30 seconds of the first alert and requested the card to be blocked. The representative assured me that the transaction had not yet gone through and confirmed the card was locked.

Despite this, the bank still allowed the transaction to be completed. To make matters worse, the investigation was abruptly closed without informing me as the cardholder. When I followed up, I was simply told that the fraud occurred due to me "disclosing my card details"—a claim that is completely baseless. The bank could not provide any evidence or even offer a written statement to support their position.

This lack of transparency and accountability is alarming. As a customer, I strongly believe this incident reflects either a serious failure in the bank’s security system or potential internal fraud. Since ENBD refused to issue any official documentation, I was unable to escalate the matter to the police for further investigation.

I’ve been a loyal ENBD customer for many years, but this experience has made it clear that my trust was misplaced. I’ve decided to end my relationship with the bank entirely.

title: My experience with Emirates NBD :
body:
I have been a customer of Emirates NBD Bank for several years, and overall, my experience has been positive. Their online and mobile banking services are user-friendly, fast, and reliable, making day-to-day transactions very convenient. The customer service team is generally helpful, and I’ve been able to resolve most issues quickly.

One of the strong points of Emirates NBD is the wide range of financial products they offer, from personal accounts to business banking solutions. Their branches and ATMs are easily accessible across the UAE, which is very convenient.

That being said, there are times when customer service response can be a bit slow, especially during peak hours, and some fees (such as for international transfers) feel higher compared to other banks.

Overall, Emirates NBD is a strong and trustworthy bank in the UAE, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for reliable banking services with modern digital solutions.

title: So clunky & longwinded
body:
The banking industry the UAE and the apps have been the most frustrating and longwinded part of relocating from the UK to UAE. The software is so slow and the amount of times clients have paid and it’s been rejected when they’ve put the details in correctly. The same goes for making payments, it’s horrendously longwinded. This applies to both business and personal. I have three banks in the UK and it is so easy to make and receive payments, never any issues and you can do it in seconds if they’re set up as a payee or that takes a minute max. It is also confirms the payee details match. Here you have to jump through hoops and wait for approvals, which can take up to eight hours. 

Honestly, the government work efficiently with apps. The banks are horrendous. My parents use FAB so may try them and someone has recommended ADCB.

title: Worst bank in the UAE
body:
Made an international transfer on 3 may - not received .. called in to complain on 17th may , told they will get back to me … no feedback. Called on 22 May - still not resolved .

We live in the most progressive country In the world yet Emirates nbd can’t account for money transferred almost 1 month ago .

The customer service don’t care ! They do not even try to assist you ! 

I have family back home waiting for the money I sent urgently since 3 may and Emirates NBD cannot be bothered to assist in finding out what the problem is
MY MONEY HAS VANISHED ! 

Absolutely disgusting service from what is meant to be a leading bank in UAE! 

I will be moving my money and closing all my accounts either them ASAP! 

Do NOT BANK WITH THEM! Avoid at all costs

title: Clearly Need More Improvement
body:
I recently encountered an issue where the app notified me that my signature needed updating and instructed me to visit the nearest branch for an instant update. However, this was misleading there was no clear information on what documents were required.

When I arrived at the branch, I was asked for my physical passport, which I didn’t have with me at the time. After driving back home to retrieve it and returning, I was then asked for a copy of my visa. This lack of upfront communication wasted nearly two hours of my time and required two separate visits just to update a signature.

This entire process could be much more efficient if:

The app provided a clear checklist of required documents before visiting the branch.
There was an option to submit documents digitally instead of requiring in-person visits for such a simple update.
Proactive notifications explained why the signature needed updating, rather than leaving me to discover the issue by chance.
The current system is inconvenient and unnecessarily time consuming. I hope this feedback helps improve the process for future customers.

title: The most horrible experience!
body:
I expected better security and customer service from Emirates NBD. My card was used without my authorization, and even after I reported the issue and had the card blocked two days ago, I received another message today stating that I must pay the outstanding amount—which has now changed from the previous statement.

It appears that someone may still be using the card, and I truly don’t understand how this is possible. It’s alarming how easily my card details were compromised, and it’s even more frustrating that the bank is not treating this matter with the seriousness it warrants.

I had even offered to settle the issue before the due date to avoid penalties, yet I’m still being held accountable for unauthorized charges. This experience has been nothing short of horrible.
To make matters worse, I only used the card once—at the Etihad Lounge for complimentary access—and never again. 

So how could this have happened?

title: Good but preferred the old one for accuracy!
body:
The new app is more comprehensive, but it comes with several frustrating flaws. Personally, I preferred the older version—it was more straightforward. This new version can be misleading.

For example, it doesn’t display the accurate credit card balance when you first open it. I’ve been misled multiple times into thinking my balance was lower than it actually was, which has caused issues. Now, I have to refresh the app 8–10 times just to get the correct figure.

It also takes far too long to reflect balance payments, which adds to the confusion. On top of that, the way it presents the outstanding balance versus the statement balance is unclear and confusing.

title: Worst customer service
body:
I'm giving this bank a zero rating due to its extremely poor customer service. Despite applying for a loan on February 10th and receiving approval on February 22nd, I still haven't received the loan amount.

To make matters worse, my daily emails to customer care have been ignored, with no response whatsoever. As a loyal customer since 2020, I'm appalled by the lack of support and accountability.

This experience has led me to regret applying for a loan with this bank and I'm now actively searching for a bank with reliable customer support.

Remember this: I paid interest without receiving the loan amount. Your bank is draining my blood and should answer to God.

title: Bring back apple pay via app
body:
I recently verified my account using Emirates ID and facial recognition, which is great for security and efficiency. However, after going through all that, it’s frustrating that I still had to manually add Apple Pay. In the previous version, it was seamlessly integrated, so this feels like a step backwards. It just doesn’t make sense to have such a detailed verification process only to end up with extra manual steps. It would be much better if the app automatically added Apple Pay after verification, like it used to.

Bring it back.
author: MrGhanim

reply.body: Hi Mr. Ghanim, thank you for reaching out to us. We value your feedback. Apple pay is now available in the App version of 15.14.1 and above. Once your device is trusted, go to Cards section, and you will see the Apple pay icon, click on it then it will show the list of cards eligible to be added, click on it then "Next", and it will ask you to enter your Smart Pass PIN to authorize the request. We hope this answers your concern and consider rerating the App. Thank you for banking with Emirates NBD.

title: Poor password management
body: The app fails to accept valid password sequences. For example, a sequence like aA8&/_[]akbhhftFfffcGbgfccddIhbgfPkh is considered as not meeting the requirements of having mixed case letters, special characters, numbers and being at least eight characters long. It expects for a very limited subset of “special characters” and rejects any others. You must be lucky to guess the characters the app is aware of. The length validator is bluntly incorrect. On top of that you can’t copy and paste when changing the password. That’s very irritating. I’ve been using this app for more than two years and I don’t see any improvements. All they did, apparently, is a redesign—now the app is even more limited than it used to be in about two years ago.

title: Best ever banking experience
body:
The Emirates NBD app is hands down one of the best banking apps I’ve ever used. It’s fast, intuitive, and packed with features that make managing finances incredibly easy. From instant transfers and bill payments to secure biometric login and SmartPass for transactions, it’s designed with the user in mind.

The interface is clean and straightforward, making navigation a breeze. I also love how I can access customer support directly through the app—it’s responsive and efficient. Plus, features like goal-based saving and card management show how much thought has gone into making this app innovative and practical.

Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a smooth and reliable banking experience!
